{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Raider''''' was a group of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] sent to assist the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Blue Fox]]'' in destroying the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Excelsior]]''. An [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] defending the ''Excelsior'' helped destroy the [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]].
